stats.title: Statistics
stats.unavailable: The statistics service is currently unavailable. Please try again later.
stats.valueNote: Annual rental value is the total annual rental payments for lots rented out. This is not the sale price of the property: state-owned property is rented out, not sold.
stats.monthlyBody: The bars show the number of lots rented out each month. The dashed line shows the average lot price for that month. This is an average, not a total: a single large lot can significantly affect the monthly figure.
stats.outcomeBody: Each lot has one of three statuses: rented out, at auction or cancelled.
stats.riseBody: Ratio of Final Price to Starting Price
stats.byPerM2: Average Annual Rent per m² (Properties up to 100 m²)
stats.perM2Note: Only properties up to 100 m² are included, accounting for 68% of all auctions. This restriction is necessary because, in some regions, natural water bodies and open land account for more than half of the properties rented out. Their rental rates are just a few so‘m per m², which significantly distorts the rates for buildings. Each region must have at least 20 observations.
stats.sizeNote: Most properties in the over 1,000 m² category are natural water bodies. There are relatively few of them, but their areas are enormous: a single lot can cover up to 48 million m². Therefore, areas are never added together on this page, and the typical (median) value is used instead of the mean. Otherwise, a typical lot would appear to cover five hectares.
stats.recordsBody: Only lots with a starting price above 1 million so‘m are included in the list of the largest price increases
stats.riseFloor: Only lots with a starting price above 1 million so‘m are included in the list of the largest price increases.
stats.registerBody: These data come from a different service and do not correspond directly to the auction results above: the register also includes rental agreements extended without an auction.
stats.scatterNote: Each circle represents a region. The horizontal axis shows the number of lots rented out. The vertical axis shows the annual rental rate per m² (for properties up to 100 m²). The size of each circle represents the region's total annual rental value. These two measures do not necessarily correspond: the region with the most lots rented out is not necessarily the one with the highest rental rates.
stats.contractsByRegionNote: The register's own data, sorted by value. This is not a timeline and should not be interpreted as growth from left to right.
stats.oneStepNote: The share of lots rented out at 1.0–1.5 times the starting price — the most common range.
stats.tenPlusNote: Lots rented out at more than ten times the starting price.
stats.cumulativeNote: Each point represents the share of lots rented out at a final price at least the indicated multiple of the starting price.
stats.avgRiseNote: The average ratio of the final price to the starting price.
